senses.gloss: the highest-ranking official representative of one country in another country
senses.example: The ambassador met with trade officials to discuss the agreement.

translations.th_TH: เอกอัครราชทูต

example_translations.zh_TW: 大使會見了貿易官員，討論該協議。
